2024-01-14.name: मकर संक्रांति
2024-01-14.significance: Sun enters Capricorn, marks end of winter and beginning of harvest season
2024-01-14.mythology: Marks the day when Bhishma Pitamah chose to leave his mortal body during Kurukshetra war
whatToDo: Take holy bath in sacred rivers (Ganga, Yamuna)
Fly kites and celebrate with family
Donate warm clothes and food to the needy
Worship Sun God and offer water

2024-01-25.name: वसंत पंचमी
2024-01-25.significance: Worship of Goddess Saraswati, beginning of spring season
2024-01-25.mythology: Day when Goddess Saraswati was born from Lord Brahma's mouth
whatToDo: Worship books, musical instruments, and learning tools
Offer yellow flowers to Goddess Saraswati
Students seek blessings for knowledge and wisdom

2024-02-19.name: छत्रपति शिवाजी जयंती
2024-02-19.significance: Birth anniversary of the great Maratha warrior king Chhatrapati Shivaji
2024-02-19.mythology: Celebrates the life and valor of Shivaji Maharaj who established the Maratha Empire
whatToDo: Remember the ideals of Shivaji Maharaj
Promote values of courage and justice

2024-03-08.name: महा शिवरात्रि
2024-03-08.significance: Greatest night of Lord Shiva, celebration of cosmic dance of creation and destruction
2024-03-08.mythology: Night when Lord Shiva performed the Tandava dance and married Goddess Parvati
whatToDo: Fast during the day (many observe complete fast)
Stay awake all night in prayer and meditation
Visit Shiva temples and offer milk, water, bel leaves
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' throughout the night
Listen to Shiva stories and bhajans

2024-03-25.name: होली
2024-03-25.significance: Festival of colors, victory of good over evil, celebration of divine love
2024-03-25.mythology: Burning of demoness Holika, love of Radha-Krishna, victory of Prahlad's devotion
whatToDo: Burn Holika bonfire on the eve (Holika Dahan)
Play with organic colors and water
Dance and sing traditional folk songs
Prepare and share festive foods like gujiya
Forgive past grievances and embrace unity

2024-04-17.name: राम नवमी
2024-04-17.significance: Birth anniversary of Lord Rama, celebration of dharma and righteousness
2024-04-17.mythology: Lord Rama was born on this day to King Dasharatha and Queen Kausalya in Ayodhya
whatToDo: Read or listen to Ramayana recitation
Visit Ram temples and participate in processions
Fast during the day, break fast at noon
Perform charitable acts and help the needy

2024-04-23.name: हनुमान जयंती
2024-04-23.significance: Birth anniversary of Lord Hanuman, symbol of devotion, strength, and service
2024-04-23.mythology: Birth of Lord Hanuman to Anjana and Kesari, blessed by Lord Vayu
whatToDo: Recite Hanuman Chalisa and Bajrang Baan
Offer red flowers, sindoor, and laddus
Read stories of Hanuman's devotion to Rama
Practice physical fitness and strength building

2024-05-10.name: अक्षय तृतीया
2024-05-10.significance: Day of eternal prosperity, auspicious for new beginnings and gold purchases
2024-05-10.mythology: Day when Treta Yuga began, also when Lord Krishna and Sudama met
whatToDo: Purchase gold or start new ventures
Worship Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi
Give gifts to family and friends

2024-05-23.name: बुद्ध पूर्णिमा
2024-05-23.significance: Birth, enlightenment, and death anniversary of Gautam Buddha
2024-05-23.mythology: Prince Siddhartha became Buddha under Bodhi tree and attained enlightenment

2024-06-17.name: निर्जला एकादशी
2024-06-17.significance: Most important Ekadashi, waterless fast for Lord Vishnu
2024-06-17.mythology: Bhima observed this fast to get benefits of all 24 Ekadashis in a year
whatToDo: Stay awake all night chanting Vishnu names
Break fast next day after sunrise

additionalInfo.label: Traditional Foods
value: No food or water during fast

2024-06-21.name: योग दिवस
2024-06-21.significance: Global celebration of yoga and its benefits for physical and mental health
2024-06-21.mythology: Ancient practice of yoga originated in India thousands of years ago

2024-07-21.name: गुरु पूर्णिमा
2024-07-21.significance: Honor spiritual teachers and gurus who guide us on the path of knowledge
2024-07-21.mythology: Birth anniversary of Sage Vyasa, author of Mahabharata and compiler of Vedas
whatToDo: Offer gratitude to your gurus and teachers
Seek blessings from elders and spiritual guides
Study sacred texts and spiritual books
Meditate and reflect on spiritual growth

2024-08-07.name: हरियाली तीज
2024-08-07.significance: Celebration of monsoon, married women fast for husband's prosperity and marital bliss
2024-08-07.mythology: Commemorates reunion of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati after her 100 years of penance
whatToDo: Married women observe fast for husbands
Worship Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati

2024-08-19.name: रक्षा बंधन
2024-08-19.significance: Sacred bond between brothers and sisters, promise of protection and love
2024-08-19.mythology: Goddess Lakshmi tied rakhi to King Bali, various stories of divine protection
whatToDo: Sisters tie rakhi on brothers' wrists
Brothers give gifts and promise protection
Remember distant siblings with video calls

2024-08-26.name: कृष्ण जन्माष्टमी
2024-08-26.significance: Birth anniversary of Lord Krishna, celebration of divine love and dharma
2024-08-26.mythology: Lord Krishna was born at midnight to Devaki and Vasudeva in Mathura prison
whatToDo: Sing Krishna bhajans and perform Ras Leela

2024-09-07.name: गणेश चतुर्थी
2024-09-07.significance: Birth celebration of Lord Ganesha, remover of obstacles and patron of arts
2024-09-07.mythology: Lord Shiva and Parvati created Ganesha from clay to guard their home
whatToDo: Install Ganesha idol at home or community
Offer modak and sweets to Lord Ganesha
Immerse idol in water on Anant Chaturdashi

2024-09-17.name: अनंत चतुर्दशी
2024-09-17.significance: Conclusion of Ganesh Chaturthi, Ganesha visarjan day
2024-09-17.mythology: Day when Lord Ganesha returns to his heavenly abode
whatToDo: Perform final aarti to Lord Ganesha
Immerse Ganesha idols in water bodies
Pray for Ganesha's return next year

2024-10-03.name: शरद नवरात्रि (प्रथम दिन)
2024-10-03.significance: Nine-day worship of Goddess Durga in her nine forms
2024-10-03.mythology: Goddess Durga fought the demon Mahishasura for nine days
whatToDo: Fast and pray for nine days
Set up Durga altar at home

2024-10-11.name: दुर्गा अष्टमी
2024-10-11.significance: Eighth day of Navratri, peak day of Durga worship
2024-10-11.mythology: Day when Goddess Durga killed the demon Mahishasura

2024-10-12.name: दशहरा/विजयदशमी
2024-10-12.significance: Victory of good over evil, Lord Rama's victory over Ravana
2024-10-12.mythology: Lord Rama killed Ravana and rescued Sita; Goddess Durga's victory over Mahishasura
whatToDo: Burn effigies of Ravana, Kumbhakarna, and Meghnad
Share sweets and joy with community

2024-10-20.name: करवा चौथ
2024-10-20.significance: Married women fast for husband's long life and prosperity
2024-10-20.mythology: Queen Veervati's devotion saved her husband's life through this fast
whatToDo: Dress in bridal attire with mehendi
Break fast after seeing moon through sieve

2024-11-01.name: धनतेरस
2024-11-01.significance: First day of Diwali, worship of Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Dhanvantari
2024-11-01.mythology: Lord Dhanvantari emerged from ocean churning with Ayurveda and nectar
whatToDo: Buy gold, silver, or new utensils

2024-11-02.name: नरक चतुर्दशी/छोटी दीवाली
2024-11-02.significance: Second day of Diwali, celebrates Krishna's victory over demon Narakasura
2024-11-02.mythology: Lord Krishna killed demon Narakasura and freed 16,000 princesses

2024-11-03.name: दीवाली/लक्ष्मी पूजा
2024-11-03.significance: Main Diwali day, return of Lord Rama to Ayodhya, worship of Goddess Lakshmi
2024-11-03.mythology: People of Ayodhya lit lamps to welcome Lord Rama after 14 years of exile

2024-11-04.name: गोवर्धन पूजा
2024-11-04.significance: Fourth day of Diwali, celebrates Krishna lifting Govardhan mountain
2024-11-04.mythology: Lord Krishna lifted Govardhan mountain to protect people from Indra's wrath
whatToDo: Create Govardhan mountain replica with cow dung

2024-11-05.name: भाई दूज
2024-11-05.significance: Fifth day of Diwali, celebrates bond between brothers and sisters
2024-11-05.mythology: Yamraj visited his sister Yamuna, who applied tilak and fed him
whatToDo: Pray for each other's long life

2024-11-15.name: गुरु नानक जयंती
2024-11-15.significance: Birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, founder of Sikhism
2024-11-15.mythology: First Sikh Guru who preached equality, unity, and devotion to one God

2024-12-25.name: Christmas
2024-12-25.significance: Birth of Jesus Christ, celebrated by Christians and others as festival of love
2024-12-25.mythology: Birth of Jesus Christ in Bethlehem, message of peace and love
whatToDo: Share feast with family and friends
